title: Okteto extension policy
description: Administrator-provided configuration, delivered through Chrome's ExtensionSettings/3rdparty policy. Tokens are never policy-provided: each user enters their own.

instanceUrl.title: Okteto instance URL
instanceUrl.description: The Okteto instance the extension queries for spaces, e.g. https://okteto.example.com. Must use https.

domains.title: Domains to inject into
domains.description: Hostnames whose requests (and their subdomains') receive the baggage header. Defaults to the instance host when omitted.

allowUserOverride.title: Allow users to change these settings
allowUserOverride.description: When false, the instance URL and domains above are enforced and the popup shows them read-only.
